beats.title: Bonogo's antidote-in-the-beer plan
beats.summary: The Dustwalker's music invades minds and floating parchments urge believers to stay for enlightenment; guards risk transforming. Bonogo is chosen to get the antidote to partiers via the beer, and executes a plan: Stafl darts the keg to make a hole, Bonogo widens it with a file, then uses his Slinkstone to teleport inside the keg.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:14-14
anchor_quotes: The Dustwalker’s music not only seeps into every inch of the rooftop, it also seems to invade the mind.
They must get the antidote to all the people at the party and the best way is through the beer.
he hands Stafl a dart and instructs him to miss the dartboard and hit the beer keg instead
touching his Slinkstone he disappears only to appear again inside the keg!

beats.title: Antidote delivered and the Charm song begins
beats.summary: Stafl realizes the antidote came from the keg and shouts the next round is on him; nearly everyone drinks as the Dustwalker plays. Ephanna spots three merchants with oily eyes chanting, Stafl's offered drinks are refused, Caelynn gets her poster signed, and the Dustwalker plays "Shephard's Wake" while guards join in.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:16-16
anchor_quotes: he shouts to the crowd that the next round was on him.
Ephanna is able to see their oily eyes as they begin to chant along with the music.
Caelynn is able to get her poster signed just before the Dustwalker reminds the crowd that after this final song they can seek the Truth.
He begins to play “Shephard’s Wake” and all the guards on the roof join in.

beats.title: Charm takes hold; party follows into the tunnels
beats.summary: Stafl and Ephanna recognize the song as a Charm. Stafl and Lysandra are compelled toward the spiral gates with password Maelthor; the party follows the crowd to the basement. Baergrom takes the empty keg to the alley, revealing Bonogo still invisible after shaking off beer, and Karsemine reports Caelynn and Ephanna following the group with Stafl and Lysandra into the tunnels.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:18-18
anchor_quotes: Immediately Stafl and Ephanna can tell that this is no ordinary song, it’s a Charm.
They must seek the spiral gates and speak the password: Maelthor.
When he removes the top he only finds beer, but a strong smell of wet “something” tells him that Bonogo is still invisible.
Karsemine runs up to inform them that Caelynn and Ephanna are following a group with Stafl and Lysandra down into the tunnels.

beats.title: Through the tunnels to the field and barn
beats.summary: The tunnels lead out of the city; Ephanna recasts Invisibility, Bonogo reappears and hides down a dark branch. At the dead end a stern Cultist demands a password; Maelthor grants entry. The tunnel opens onto a field with a float-goat pond and a barn with spiral doors and gates, about 30 humans gathered. Karsemine trips Stafl to break the Charm, bloodying his nose. Bonogo sneaks to the field's far end and lights oil at the barn corner as everyone files inside; Ephanna smells smoke.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:20-20
anchor_quotes: Baergrom notices that the tunnels are slowly leading out of the city.
Quickly the group remembers the name “Maelthor” and the Cultist cracks a huge smile and invites them in
Then the tunnel opens up right into a field outside the city - complete with a pond of float goats and a huge barn with spiral doors and gates.
Bonogo sneaks up to a corner of the barn and pours out oil, then lights it on fire.

beats.title: Barn ritual interrupted; Fleshborn ambush
beats.summary: Inside the barn the priest speaks and humans eat the meat. Caelynn doses Lysandra with antidote and Shocking Grasps her free of the Charm. The priest chants with the crowd and the Dustwalker's music; two robed Cultists wheel in a cart with twin goblin children for a sacrifice. Stafl casts Hideous Laughter on the priest. The Dustwalker monologues that he knew the Questionable Company was at the guardhouse, would follow to the barn, and fall into his trap. Six Cultists explode into tentacled Fleshborn, Cultists surround the party, the room panics, and time stutters.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:22-22
anchor_quotes: then uses Shocking Grasp to knock her out of the Charmed effect.
Two robed Cultists walk down the center aisle with a cart - twin goblin children inside.
Stafl, reacting quickly, casts Hideous Laughter on the priest and he falls to the ground laughing hysterically.
he knew the Questionable Company was at the party at the guardhouse, he knew that we would follow the cultists to the barn, he knew they would fall right into his trap.
they become Fleshborn

beats.title: Battle in the burning barn
beats.summary: Karsemine Hunter's Marks and Fire Bolts the Dustwalker. Stafl reveals wings, flies up, and plays the Song of Shattering on the Peacemaker Fiddle, damaging and disorienting enemies. Bonogo pushes the cart back in and slams the doors; Ephanna warns the barn is on fire and misses an Eldritch Blast. A Fleshborn tentacle hits Caelynn with necrotic damage and absorbs a human; Cultists chant at Lysandra but the Charm fails.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:24-25
anchor_quotes: Karsemine uses Hunter’s Mark on Dustwalker then hits him with a Fire Bolt.
Stafl reveals his wings, flies up to the center of the barn and pulls out the Peacemaker Fiddle and plays the Song of Shattering.
Ephanna yells to the rest of the Questionable Company that the barn is on fire and to make a run for it.
one of the horrible flesh monsters lashes out with a savage tentacle attack on Caelynn, Baergrom and one of the random humans that was nearby.

beats.title: Caelynn and Baergrom counter; doors locked
beats.summary: Caelynn unleashes a Lightning Bolt that kills Cultists, damages Fleshborn and the Dustwalker, and blows a hole in the barn. Baergrom strikes a monster four times, knocks it prone, uses Evasive Footwork, and exits—only for outside Cultists to slam and lock the doors, trapping Baergrom and Ephanna outside and the rest in. Flesh monsters kill and absorb the remaining humans; Lysandra withstands the damage and runs for the locked doors with Caelynn.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:27-27
anchor_quotes: Caelynn floats back into position and then unleashes a devastating Lightning Bolt in a line from one end of the barn to the other - killing several Cultists, dealing major damage to the Fleshborn, dealing huge damage to the Dustwalker and blowing a hole out the other end of the barn.
Baergrom draws his longsword and trusty Hearthwarden Shield and quickly strikes a monster four times before bashing it with his shield and knocking it prone.
Just as Baergrom exits the barn the Cultists outside move in and slam the doors shut, locking Baergrom and Ephanna out and everyone else in.
Lysandra turns and makes a run for the doors with Caelynn, but finds them locked.

beats.title: Dustwalker's new song; desperate straits
beats.summary: The Dustwalker plays a new song building to something big. Flesh monsters corner and grapple Caelynn and Lysandra, both dangerously low. A remaining monster leaps and strikes the floating Stafl with psychic damage, pulling him to the ground. Cultists' Dark Whispers again have no effect. Outside the fire grows up the barn walls and spreads.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-6:c4fe6d1592e9:span:c4fe6d1592e9:29-29
anchor_quotes: Grinning, the Dustwalker begins to play a new song, clearly building up to something big.
The flesh monsters corner Lysandra and Caelynn, attacking both for major damage and, in her weakened state, Caelynn is grappled.
The monster leaps into the air and lands an attack with its long tentacles dealing psychic damage and pulling Stafl back to the ground.
Outside, the fire begins to grow - moving up the walls of the barn and spreading out in every direction.
